estimates.anchor_source: No market (Kalshi KXABNB nights ladder, Polymarket price ladders only, 2026-09-17T08:21:21Z). Anchor = the repo's adopted line-build path (docs/margin-build/notes/40_line_build.md, 15 Sep 2026): reconciled 4Q26 cost of revenue $578M (+18.7%) above the $575M threshold -> P(leg 2) ~0.57 under its hosting mix, plus leg 1 -> 0.63. Base rate: cost-of-revenue/GBV ratio up >= +4.7% y/y in 1 of 10 quarters (0.20 with the hosting shift) unioned with a 0.13 chance of an AI/hosting dollar figure (0 of 5 February letters). Decomposition: line-build formula Monte Carlo with a hosting-step mixture.
estimates.independence_note: the anchor takes the line build's reconciliation step (30% of a $97M inferred gap) as a run-rate fact; this log weights it 0.20 because the contracted hosting step is a 2027 event (FY25 10-K: $219M in 2026 vs ~$465M/yr in 2027-28)

model.conventions: leg 2 on the income-statement cost-of-revenue line (FY26 less 9M where needed); leg 1 needs a management statement (letter, call, 10-K MD&A) with a dollar or convertible percentage >= $50M of incremental FY27 AI/hosting/infrastructure spend; the 10-K purchase-obligations table alone does not count; statements at the 5 Nov print count

impact.note: Conditional mean if Yes: 4Q26 cost of revenue ~$590M (+$12M vs the line build's $578M; 4Q26 margin -0.4pp, FY26 -0.1pp) and FY27 hosting/AI ~+$100M vs the line build's $330M (-0.32pp per $50M -> -0.6pp; -$0.14 EPS at $0.0014/$M). Against the Street, which carries no step, the FY27 gap is ~-0.9pp. Stock -$4 = level effect (-$100M x ~16x / 620m ~ -$2.6) plus the investment-year read (~-$1.5). EV 0.38 x -4 = -$1.5/share: material at the margin; carry as a bonus line keyed to the 5 Nov cost-of-revenue print.

sensitivity.assumption: hosting-step mixture -> line-build full reconciliation step
convention: 10-K commitments table counts as a quantification
